title: ImageResize removes EXIF data, with "Remove metadata" turned off

judgment.rationale: Draft PR 47888 directly implements JPEG metadata preservation and EXIF reconstruction for this re-encode failure.
evidence: The report specifically loses GPS and camera metadata with metadata removal disabled.
PR 47888 targets the JPEG re-encode path and lists GPS, descriptive EXIF, dimensions, corrupted EXIF, and strip-metadata regression coverage.
judgment.recommended_action: Track PR 47888 rather than produce competing work.

fix_assessment.rationale: The open draft PR directly covers the affected JPEG re-encode and metadata-preservation path.

issue_context.summary: Image Resizer removes JPEG EXIF metadata even when metadata removal is disabled; an open draft implementation directly covers that path.
known_information: Reports span 0.99 through 0.100.2 and include GPS and camera metadata.
PR 47888 reconstructs JPEG EXIF after re-encoding and adds focused coverage.
inferences: The PR must still be validated against the reporter's overwrite and quality settings before merge.
issue_context.analysis: A concrete, actively maintained fix exists, so a second design would duplicate effort.
initial_investigation: Read the issue discussion and current PR description, commit, and validation inventory.

information_gaps.information: Maintainer review and final validation of PR 47888
information_gaps.why_needed: The implementation is a draft and has not yet established release readiness.
information_gaps.how_to_collect: Review the PR's regression results against a JPEG containing GPS and camera metadata with removal disabled.
